title: The Endless Frontier read as working back from airdropped alien tech

tellings.quote: if you think if you read the endless frontier with this new lens of like maybe we have derivative alien technology

plain: Science, The Endless Frontier, a 1945 report by Vannevar Bush, a top American wartime science official, takes on a new meaning if you read it as if the United States already had technology derived from aliens, says Michels. He offers this reading himself as a theory, not something the report says. If it were right, the plan for postwar American science would have been partly a way of working back from alien technology.
